title: Kanban column header with count
discoveries: Zustand UISlice pattern extends easily with Record<string, boolean> for multi-item toggleable state
DropdownMenuTrigger render prop pattern enables custom button styling without wrapper element
Animated SVG icons (ChevronDown with -rotate-90) provide visual feedback for state changes
Combining icon button + dropdown menu for dual interaction (toggle + actions)
what_worked_well: Followed existing UISlice pattern from F024 (sidebarCollapsed) exactly - pattern reuse achieved feature in single iteration
Using installed shadcn DropdownMenu component - render prop pattern matched existing codebase conventions
Proactive accessibility improvements: aria-labels on all icon-only buttons (collapse toggle and options menu)
Render prop pattern in DropdownMenuTrigger allowed custom icon button without wrapper divs
Single-responsibility: UI state in Zustand, component handles presentation only
recommendations_for_next: For multi-item boolean state in Zustand, Record<string, boolean> pattern is proven - use spread operator to update
Always add aria-label to icon-only buttons - combine with descriptive label that reflects state (e.g., 'Expand column' when collapsed)
DropdownMenu render prop is more idiomatic than children - prefer render for custom button styling
Consider extracting column header styling into separate component if more columns use similar patterns

PAT-025: Icon button accessibility with context-aware aria-labels
